map.求真空电磁波波阻抗 使用指南: Vacuum electromagnetic wave impedance user guide
map.真空波阻抗计算器。按 Z₀ = √(μ₀/ε₀) ≈ 376.73 Ω 计算自由: Vacuum wave impedance calculator. Computes the intrinsic impedance of a plane electromagnetic wave in free space as Z₀ = √(μ₀/ε₀), about 376.73 Ω; the result can be used as a reference for antenna matching, electromagnetic wave propagation and transmission line characteristic impedance.
map.天线匹配：50Ω/75Ω 系统与 Z₀=377Ω 自由空间的辐射关系。: Antenna matching: radiation relationship between 50 Ω/75 Ω systems and Z₀ = 377 Ω free space.
map.卫星链路：自由空间传播损耗 FSPL 与 Z₀ 相关。: Satellite links: the free-space path loss FSPL is related to Z₀.
map.微波传输：波导特性阻抗由几何决定。: Microwave transmission: waveguide characteristic impedance is determined by geometry.
map.EMC 测试：辐射骚扰场强计算。: EMC testing: radiated disturbance field strength calculation.
map.：Z₀≈376.7Ω；半波振子理论阻抗 ≈73Ω，对称振子经巴伦匹配到 50Ω: : Z₀ is about 376.7 Ω; the theoretical impedance of a half-wave dipole is about 73 Ω, and a symmetric dipole is matched to a 50 Ω system through a balun.
map.由匝数、截面积与长度求电感: Inductance from turns, cross-sectional area and length
map.真空中与频率无关；介质中 Z=√(μ/ε) 与频率无关（无损介质），但色散介质时: In vacuum it is independent of frequency; in a medium Z = √(μ/ε) is independent of frequency (lossless medium) but varies in dispersive media. map.为何射频常用 50Ω 而非 377Ω？: Why is 50 Ω standard for RF rather than 377 Ω?
map.50Ω 综合权衡损耗（同轴线最小损耗阻抗约 77Ω）、功率容量（同轴约 30Ω）: 50 ohms balances loss (the minimum-loss impedance of coaxial line is about 77 ohms), power handling (about 30 ohms for coax) and test instrument standards. map.FSPL 公式来源？: Where does the FSPL formula come from?
map.FSPL=(4πd/λ)²；本质来自各向同性辐射器在球面上的能流密度 S=E²/: FSPL = (4πd/λ)²; it essentially comes from the decay of the energy flux density S = E²/(2Z₀) of an isotropic radiator over a spherical surface.
